SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM (
  SELECT 'class' AS kind, symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND is_public = TRUE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'function' AS kind, symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'function' AND is_public = TRUE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'method' AS kind, symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'method' AND is_public = TRUE
) AS all_public
WHERE symbol_id NOT LIKE '%@L%'  -- exclude repeated qualified definitions
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: This query first selects all public symbols of each kind (class, function, method) from the symbols table, then filters out repeated qualified definitions (those containing '@L' which indicate multiple definitions of the same qualified name), and finally groups by kind to count how many public symbols of each type exist in the non-test code.
sql:
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM (
  SELECT 'class' AS kind, symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND is_public = TRUE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'function' AS kind, symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'function' AND is_public = TRUE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'method' AS kind, symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'method' AND is_public = TRUE
) AS all_public
WHERE symbol_id NOT LIKE '%@L%'  -- exclude repeated qualified definitions
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind
